pages.title: About TAKE.Health
pages.description: Taking control of your health should not feel confusing. Take Health turns health data into clear, personal insights.
copy: Taking control of your health should not feel confusing. Take Health was built to change that.
Your health data, transformed into clear, science-backed insights personalized to help you take control and build a longer, healthier life.

pages.title: How TAKE.Health Works
pages.description: Upload diagnostic reports and lab results, read the markers in plain language, and compare past and present reports in one place.
copy: 1,000+ health markers analyzed.
Step 1. Drop your reports. Securely upload your diagnostic reports and lab results.
Step 2. We analyze it for you. The platform reads key markers and turns complex information into clear insights.
Step 3. Tailored wellness recommendations, focused on everyday health.
Step 4. Compare past and present reports in one place.

pages.title: Privacy Policy | TAKE.Health
pages.description: Privacy policy for take.health, operated by TAKE Solutions Limited, listed on the NSE and BSE, with its registered office in Chennai, India.
copy: Your privacy is important to us. Please read the privacy policy carefully.

Take.health is operated by TAKE Solutions Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act 2013 and listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) of India. The registered office is in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.
The platform is available at www.take.health and through the iOS and Android apps. This policy explains what personal data is collected, why it is used, and what rights you have.

Where you choose to connect a wearable, Apple Watch and WHOOP connect directly. Other wearables connect through Apple Health or Google Health Connect. TAKE.Health does not sell wearable or health-platform data.
